_doc: Day-level bootstrap of Profit Factor for August 2026 (2026-08-01..2026-08-27, 5 active arms, 19 trading days), at increasing cost realism: as-traded (paper) -> +regulatory fees only -> +2c/contract exit slippage -> +5c/contract exit slippage. 20000 resamples with replacement over trading DAYS (not trades) to respect within-day trade correlation. Methodology: percentile bootstrap, gains/losses summed at the day level.
